thread:
elaine: heads up — noticed a weird TTL behavior in the Console observability example (dashboard snippet). The example sets "cacheTTL: 0" but in prod it looks like prefixes are still being cached for ~30s. can someone confirm?

mike: hmm, I remember a change in the runtime that treats 0 as 'use default' unless explicitly set to null. might be an SDK -> console translation bug. do you have the snippet link?

elaine: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/console/observability/dashboard-examples.md#kv-cache-example 

elaine: snippet (from the page):
```yaml
- name: kv-cache-example
  type: dashboard
  spec:
    kvCache:
      enabled: true
      cacheTTL: 0  # intended: disable caching in this example
```

mike: thanks. if SDK interprets 0 as missing then the backend applies default TTL. easy fix on docs side: change to `cacheTTL: null` + comment explaining that null disables cache.

yusuf: that'll change meaning though, we should make it explicit in the example and add a short note in the migration guide. There was an older runtime version where 0 meant disable. we broke compatibility during quantization patch.

katie: I can take the docs PR. quick checklist: update the snippet, add a footnote about runtime versions (< v2.4) where 0 disables caching, and run linkcheck.

elaine: awesome — PR would also need a tiny unit for the snippet linter, otherwise ci-linkcheck flags the anchor.

mike: created a tiny branch `docs/ttl-null-example` to test the change locally. command to preview: `mkdocs serve --config docs/mkdocs.yml` (from repo root).

katie: noted. i'll open the PR and add you as reviewer, @mike for the runtime note and @yusuf for migration copy.

katie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4657 — description: "Console: make KV cache disablement explicit in dashboard snippet; note runtime compatibility"

docs-bot: link-check: failed — 1 anchor broken in console/observability/dashboard-examples.md (line ~134).

mike: that's the anchor for the code example id. i can patch the anchor in the same PR, small change.

katie: pushed two commits: update snippet to `cacheTTL: null` and fixed the fragment `#kv-cache-example` -> `#kv-cache-example-1`. CI re-run queued.

deploy-bot: preview deployed — https://deploy.previews.redwood-inference.com/docs/4657 — checks: linter ✅, link-check pending.

docs-bot: link-check: passed.

yusuf: LGTM. small nit: add a one-liner in the migration guide (docs/migrations/runtime-compat.md) mentioning the change from 0 -> default in v2.4 and how to preserve old behavior by setting `legacyZeroTtl: true` at runtime config.

katie: added migration line and a tiny example snippet. pushed.

mike: approved review and left a comment about runtime flag naming (suggest `legacy_zero_ttl` snake_case for the on-prem docs consistency).

yusuf: fine with either, but use snake_case in example to be consistent with other runtime flags. i'll follow up in a runtime docs PR if needed.

katie: merged PR 4657 — thanks all. :tada: will backport to the 2.x branch.

elaine: thanks! one follow-up — can someone add an automated smoke test that loads that example and asserts no caching when `cacheTTL: null`? low priority but would prevent regressions.

mike: filed GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1883 — smoke test for kv cache disablement. assigned to eng-runtime backlog.

yusuf: ping me if you want help adding the integration test, i can pair.

katie: closing the thread after backport PR opens against release/2.x. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
